## Observations

1. **Champion holds** - Better tuning consistency and drawdown control
2. **Candidate weakness** - Tuning min of 0.05 indicates instability on at least one fold
3. **Candidate strength** - Slightly better lockbox minimum (more robust out-of-sample floor)

## Ready to Execute

```bash
# 1. Module-level optimization
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
    --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
    --run --select-best

# 2. System-level candidates
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
    --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
    --run

# 3. Generate fix recommendations
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
    --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
    --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Priority Focus
- Investigate fold with tuning_min = 0.05 in candidate
- Consider if `exp_macro_alpha_shadow` module can be stabilized without losing lockbox floor gain

Shall I proceed with the next commands?
